concerns.text: The plan cites an external HuggingFace dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/fwerkor/CID-Dataset/…) as the source for “FWER Null‑Simulation Data”. FR‑007 requires a null‑simulation that reflects the same statistical structure (visual‑complexity metrics and cognitive‑load outcomes) used in the primary analysis. Using an unrelated dataset of generic “complex‑logic” jobs does not provide appropriate null data for this study and may invalidate the family‑wise error‑rate check. Replace the external dataset with a synthetic null‑simulation generated in‑pipeline (e.g., random draws of the three visual‑complexity metrics and random TLX/RT values with zero true effect) or provide a dataset explicitly designed for null‑simulation of the study variables.
